page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.4xlarge is an x86_64 compute instance belonging to the High Clock Speed family. It runs on the KVM hypervisor and is powered by an Intel Xeon 6149 processor clocked at 3.1 GHz. The hardware configuration provides 8 physical cores and 16 vCPUs via multithreading, backed by dedicated CPU allocation. Memory capacity measures 64.0 GB, delivering a balanced 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio, supported by 22 MB of Level 3 cache and instruction set support including AVX-512 and AES cryptography.

The instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated hardware accelerators, requiring external block storage for persistent filesystem needs. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 3 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Benchmark measurements show mid-range multi-threaded capability, scoring 14,412.57 in stress-ng multi-core and 6,665.0 in Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory read throughput reaches 72.73 GB/sec on large 256 MB blocks, accompanied by solid key-value performance of 14.17 million Redis SET operations per second and 8.19 GB/sec static web throughput.

Single-core performance trails newer microarchitectures, as indicated by a Geekbench single-core score of 1,106.0 and lower efficiency in single-threaded gzip compression. Similarly, larger compute loads like 7B parameter LLM inference exhibit lower throughput. Consequently, the instance offers balanced density and dependable resource isolation for multi-threaded applications, enterprise web serving, backend application servers, and distributed compilation workloads that rely on consistent CPU frequency rather than high burst single-thread execution.

The instance includes 22 MB of L3 cache, AVX-512 extensions, and a 3 Gbps baseline network interface. It features no integrated local storage or hardware accelerators, depending on attached network storage. This configuration is suitable for multi-threaded enterprise software, web application backends, mid-tier databases, and build automation pipelines.
